map.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / game sprite camera correction.
Edit the attached golden Eddie horse trophy reference. Preserve the same recognizable cheerful golden horse, sculpted swept mane, gold eyes and muzzle, raised waving hoof on viewer-left, star cup held on viewer-right, tail, polished and satin gold metal, and substantial three-step rounded rectangular GOLD pedestal with blank front plaque.

CRITICAL CAMERA/ORIENTATION CORRECTION: the reference is diagonally turned. Re-render the trophy facing EXACTLY SOUTH, straight toward the viewer/bottom edge of the map, with ZERO left/right yaw and ZERO camera roll. Keep an elevated camera looking down about 40–45 degrees at the upright statue, so tops of mane, shoulders, open cup and pedestal are visible. This is an elevated STRAIGHT FRONT view, NOT a three-quarter side view. Eddie's head and torso face directly forward without sideways tilt; the face's centerline is vertical and the two eyes align horizontally. Keep the waving arm asymmetry, but not a tilted head/body.

PEDESTAL GEOMETRY IS ESSENTIAL: front face of every rectangular step must face directly toward the bottom of the canvas. Its long front edge and the top and bottom edges of its blank plaque must be perfectly HORIZONTAL. Left and right sides recede equally and symmetrically. Show a level broad top plane. No diagonal front edge, no skewed plaque, no angled base, no standing on one corner. Both feet planted evenly.

Centered full trophy, entire ears, wave, tail and gold base fully visible, square canvas with generous margins. Warm key light upper-left. Clean sculpted metallic gold, crisp silhouette readable at 150px map size, no extra decorations or sparkle particles (animated sparkles added separately in website).
BACKGROUND: absolutely flat pure chroma blue RGB(0,0,255) everywhere outside the trophy, also inside gaps. No gradients, shadow cast onto blue, textured backdrop, floor, checkerboard, text, watermark, scene or platform. The blue is a temporary sprite extraction background, not part of the statue.
map.preparation: Built-in editor corrected camera yaw to straight south with an elevated viewpoint. Generated flat blue background is converted to sprite alpha using tools/build-golden-eddie-map.cjs; sculpture geometry is unchanged by preparation.
